title: #6 Death Of Rasool Ullah & Khaleefah Of The Messenger Of Allah
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله  وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا إنَّ الله خيرا عبدًا مِن عباده بين الدنيا وبين ما عندالله فختارا ذالك العبد ما عندالله

إنَّ أمنَّ الناس عليَّ في صحبته ، وماله أبوبكر ولو كنت متخذً خليلً غير ربي لتخذت ابابكر خليل ولكن أخوة الإسلام ومودة لا يبقين في المسجد باب إلَّا سدَّا إلَّا باب أبي بكرٍ رواه البخاري

مُرُوا أبَا بَكْرٍ أنْ يُصَلِّيَ بالنَّاسِ، إنَّ أبي رجلٌ أصيف مُرُوا أبَا بَكْرٍ أنْ يُصَلِّيَ بالنَّاسِ، إنَّكُنَّ لَأَنْتُنَّ صَوَاحِبُات يُوسُفَ،

أشدُّ النَّاسِ بلاءً ، الأنبياءُ ، فا الأمثلُ فالأمثلُ ، وقدماه تخطان في الأرض كُنتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ لا تَزالُ طائفةٌ مِن أُمَّتي على الحقِّ

وَكِدنا نُفتَنُ عن صلاتِنا نُفتَنُ عن صلاتِنا ألحب إبن ألحب وكان بين صحري ونحري بَلِ الرّفيقُ الأعْلَى، بَلِ الرّفيقُ الأعْلَى، بَلِ الرّفيقُ الأعْلَى

بَلِ الرّفيقُ الأعْلَى اَلْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ الْإِسْلَامَ دِينًا أللهم أغفرلي ورحمني ولحقني رفيق الأعلى

اللهم الرّفيقُ الأعْلَى مَن أحَبَّ لقاءَ اللهِ أحَبَّ اللهُ لقاءَه ولم توفي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من طرب المسلمون فمنهم من دوحش فخلد ومنهم من أقعد فلم يطقد قيام

ومنهم من تقل لسانه فلم يطق الكلام وطرف الحال فكان موت النبي قاسمة الزهري ومصيبت الأمر أمَّا علي فستخفى بيت فاطمه وامَّا عثمان  فسكت وأمَّا عمر فأهجر وقال ما مات رسول الله

وإنَّما وعده ربه كما وعد موسى وليرجعن رسول الله فاليقطعن ايدي رجالٍ وأرجلهم من كان يعبد محمداً فإن محمداً قد مات ومن كان يعبد الله فإن الله حي لا يموت

وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلاَّ رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ أَفَإِنْ مَاتَ أَوْ قُتِلَ انْقَلَبْتُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِكُمْ وَمَنْ يَنْقَلِبْ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَنْ يَضُرَّ اللهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيَجْزِي اللهُ الشَّاكِرِين۝

نحن الأنصار وكَتِيْبَةُ الْإسلام وكنت أداري منه بعد الحد يا معشرالأنصار ألستم تعلمون أنَّ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم امارة ابوبكرأن يا أمة با الناس

فايكم تطيب نفسه ان يتقدم ابا بكر نعوذوبالله والله ما كنت حريصًا على العِمارة يومًا ولا ليلةً قط ولا كنت فيها راغبًا ولا سعلته الله عزَّوَجل في سرٍّ وعلانية

ولكني أشفقتم من الفتنة ومالي في إمارة في المراء ولكن قلت أمرًا عظيمًا مالي بهم من طاقة، ولا يده إلَّا بتقوية الله عزوجل ولا ودت أنَّ أقو الناس عليها ماكان

إنَّ هذالأمر في قريش أَتَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النبيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عليه وسلَّمَ، فأمَرَهَا أنْ تَرْجِعَ إلَيْهِ قَالَتْ: أرَأَيْتَ إنْ جِئْتُ ولَمْ أجِدْكَ؟ كَأنَّهَا تَقُولُ: المَوْتَ

قَالَ صَلَّى اللهُ عليه وسلَّمَ: إنْ لَمْ تَجِدِينِي فَأْتي أبَا بَكْرٍ وفي الحديث أنَّا مواعيد النبي كانت على من يتول الخلافة بعده تنجيزها وفيه ردٌّ على شيعة في زعمِهم أنَّه نسَّها إستخلاف علي والعبَّاس

وفي نضعه ضعف ولله يغفروله رؤیاء الأنبياء وحي الذي بلغ وعمرفي طول مدت Ayesha رضي الله عنها said; نعوذوبالله إنْ لَمْ تَجِدِينِي فَأْتي أبَا بَكْرٍ

فلو كانت تعين مما يشتبع الأمة لو بين له رسول الله صلى الله بيان القطعًا للعزر متی بوع یا علی ابي بكر؟

كره أن يبقه بعديومٍ وليس في جماعة وكان رضي الله عنه مفروض طاعة لإجماع المسلمين على طاعة فكانت الإمامة أصلًى عليه إستقرد قواعد المِلَّةْ إنَّ الله جلت قدرته’ ندب الأمة زعيمًا خلف به نبوة و حاطبه الملة

english:
Rasool Allah ﷺ was delivering a Khut'ba(خطبة), and he said; Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has given one of His slaves, two choices.

The first choice is to stay in this world.

The second choice is to leave to die and to go to what Allah سبحانه وتعالى has for that person in the afterlife and that slave has chosen the latter.

That slave has chosen to go to what Allah has reserved for him in the afterlife.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه started crying.

Abu Saeed Al-Khudri(أبوسعيدألخدري) one of the Ansaar(أنْصَار). He said: We looked at Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) and we couldn't figure out, why he is crying.

It doesn't seem to be something very emotional about that statement.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has given one of His slaves, the choice of staying in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) or leaving Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), given him the choice of living longer, or dying.

So, why is Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) crying?

Abu Saeed Al-Khudri(أبوسعيدألخدري) said; But then we came to know why he cried Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه was the only one among us who understood what Rasool Allah ﷺ meant.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was actually talking about himself.

He was that slave of Allah.

But you see Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه because of the fact that he has spent so much time with Rasool Allah ﷺ more than anyone else among the Sahabah(صحابه)

he could understand Rasool Allah ﷺ better and more than anybody else.

And he can get the message sometimes without Rasool Allah ﷺ even speaking it because they have been friends for their entire lives.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه was weeping, and then Rasool Allah ﷺ said the following, The one, who has done me, the greatest favors through his friendship to me, and his wealth, is Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Now imagine Rasool Allah ﷺ saying this towards the end of his life in front of all of the Sahabah(صحابه) an admission, a recognition of his close friend and companion, Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

He is saying that he has done me so many favors.

In fact another Hadith(حديث),  Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Every one of you, who has done me a favor, I have paid them back except Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق).

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Rasool Allah ﷺ said: And if I were to take a Khalil(خليل) a Khalil(خليل) is something higher than a Sahib(صاحب), a Sahib(صاحب) is a friend

Khalil(خليل) is a higher level of friendship, very close.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: If I was to take a Khalil(خليل) besides Allah it would be Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying that I'm the Khalil(خليل) of Allah that he is the Khalil(خليل) of Allah.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is the Khalil(خليل) of Allah.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; If I were to be a Khalil(خليل) of someone else, it would be Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) but between us is Akhuwat-Tul-Islam(أخوة الإسلام)

the brotherhood of Islam Wa-Muwaddato(ومودةُ) and the love of Islam.

That's the relationship between me and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ said, you know, in the Masjid-e-Nabawi(مسجد النبوي).

The Sahabah(صحابه), particularly the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) they were given small pieces of land next to the Masjid(مسجد).

So they would build their houses, right next to the walls of Masjid-e-Nabawi(مسجد النبوي) and they would open for themselves very small gates

so that they could immediately walk from their house to the Masjid(مسجد).

So, these were private doors of some of the Sahabah(صحابه) and there are quite a few of them, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: And I want all of these private doors to be closed except for the door of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

That's the privilege that only goes to Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه the one who will have a private entrance into Al-Masjid-e-Nabawi(ألمسجد النبوي).

Imagine having your private gate, no one gets in except you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: All of them should be closed except the gate of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and this is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه got the message that Rasool Allah ﷺ is towards the end of his life.

Rasool Allah ﷺ became ill that was a few months after he came back from Hajjat-Ul-Widaa(حجة الوداع).

Rasool Allah ﷺ, his illness was getting worse and worse and he was unable to join in Salaat-Ul-Jama'at(صلوات الجماعة).

So he said: Instruct Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to be the Imam(اِمَام), in Salah(صلاة).

Ayesha رضي الله عنها when she heard that she was trying to change the mind of Muhammadﷺ.

She said; My father is very soft hearted and if he stands in your place, he will break down.

It's not easy to be standing in the same place of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

She said: If he stands in that position, He might break down, he's very soft hearted.

So, why don't you tell Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) to take that position.

In reality, Ayesha رضي الله عنها also had another reason for not wanting her father to be there to give you an example to draw the point closer.

Imagine that you came a very long distance to hear Khut'ba(خطبة) from a very well known scholar.

There's an ad that says that this very well known scholar is coming into town and he's going to give Khut'ba(خطبة).

So you come from all over London to attend this Khut'ba(خطبة).

And then you come there, and we find that it's not this scholar you came to hear, its someone else you're not gonna like that.

Ayesha رضي الله عنها was thinking that this is a place where the people are expecting Rasool Allah ﷺ to be.

So when they see my father, they're not gonna like that.

They're used to Rasool Allah ﷺ leading them that position.

So she wanted to change the mind of Rasool Allah ﷺ, she said; Why don't you have Umar(عُمَر) do it?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Instruct Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to be the Imam(اِمَام) She again suggested otherwise, Rasool Allah ﷺ the third time said; You're like the woman of Yousuf(يوسف)

tell Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to lead the people in Salah(صلاة).

What Rasool Allah ﷺ meant by the woman of Yousuf(يوسف)?

The woman of Yousuf(يوسف) they showed something they didn't really mean they had a different motive.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ felt that there is a different motive here why she doesn't want her father to be the Imam(اِمَام).

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه became the Imam(اِمَام) of the Muslims for a few days, he was leading them in Salah(صلاة).

And by the way, Abul Hasan Al-Ash'ari(أبوالحسن ألأشعري) he uses this as an evidence that Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه is the greatest scholar in this Ummah(امة),

he says because Rasool Allah ﷺ says that the one, who should lead the Salah(صلاة) is the one, who has most knowledge in the book of Allah.

So since Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was told to lead the Muslims in Salah(صلاة) it's not just because he's the friend of Rasool Allah ﷺ and he is close companion

but also because he has the most Fiqh(فقه).

The deepest knowledge in Islam or understanding in Islam and Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر), he comments on these words of Abul Hasan Al-Ash'ari(أبوالحسن ألأشعري) and says;

This should be written in letters of gold.

They're very valuable words in proving that Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) is in fact the most scholarly person in this Ummah(امة).

One day Rasool Allah ﷺ felt better.

He was still very exhausted and Rasool Allah ﷺ was once touched by Abdullah Ibn Masood(عبدالله إبن مسعود).

So he saw that the temperature of Rasool Allah ﷺ was very high so he said: O Messenger of Allah, you have a very strong fever.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes! We the prophets, our fever is double the fever of everyone else.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says; The people, who go through the most severe tests are the Prophets and then it goes down, according to your level.

So the greater a person is and the closer they are to Allah, the more difficult the test would be.

Just like when you take an exam there are some questions that only an A student would be able to handle not everybody else would be able to handle them.

And there are some questions who're only the A plus could answer because these are very difficult questions.

So Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ puts the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) through some very difficult tests.

Now the narrator of the Hadith(حديث) said; And I could see Rasool Allah ﷺ being carried by two men Al-Abbas(العباس) and Ali Ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه.

And his feet are dragging on the ground that was how ill Rasool Allah ﷺ was he can't even move his feet and he is carried by the two companions, رضي الله عنهم.

They already started the Salah(صلاة).

So when Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه saw Rasool Allah ﷺ coming he retreated he wanted to go back.

Rasool Allah ﷺ waved to him and told him to stay where you are and then Rasool Allah ﷺ came and sat next to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and he started leading him in Salah(صلاة).

So Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is following Rasool Allah ﷺ and the Sahabah(صحابه) are following Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and then Rasool Allah ﷺ went back again.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه carried on leading the Mo'mineen(مؤمنين) in Salah(صلاة), until it was Monday the 12 of Rabiul-Awwal(ربيع الأول).

In Salaat-Ul-Fajr(صلاةالافجر) Rasool Allah ﷺ opened his curtain and he was standing, and he took a look at the Sahabah(صحابه) in Salah(صلاة)

the room of Ayesha(عائشه) was right there, touching the Masjid(مسجد).

So the only thing separating the room from the Masjid(مسجد) was a curtain.

Rasool Allah ﷺ uncovered that curtain and he took a look at the Sahabah(صحابه) praying in Salaat-Ul-Fajr(صلاةالافجر) the Masjid(مسجد) is full and Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه is reciting Qur'an in Salah(صلاة).

When Rasool Allah ﷺ saw that he smiled and you could see happiness in his face so the narrator of the Hadith(حديث) said; The face of Rasool Allah ﷺ became like a plate of silver,

it was shining with light.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was so happy because Rasool Allah ﷺ was now seeing the fruit of his harvest.

He is seeing the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم, performing the Salah(صلاة) the greatest duty in Islam.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ was seeing with his own eyes the success of his message.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was the most successful of all of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allah with other Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), when they pass away their Ummah(امة) cannot carry on after them.

They go down, down, down, until they reached to the bottom and then Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has to send another Nabi(نَبِي) to bring them up.

With Bannu Israel(بنواسرائيل) at a particular time they had 70 Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) at one moment, to keep them on the straight path but Rasool Allah ﷺ has succeeded in his message so well to the extent that there's no need for a prophet after him

and his students are so successful. As Allah سبحانه وتعالى said; You're the best Ummah(امة) brought forth for mankind that they will carry on with His message, carrying the banner of Islam until the day of judgment.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; There will remain a group of my Ummah(امة) on straight path until the day of judgment, until they end up fighting with Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال).

So Rasool Allah ﷺ was so happy that he felt now he is ready to leave, his mission is completed.

He can entrust the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم with the responsibility with appointing their own leader, with carrying on the message of Islam.

And that's why the face of Rasool Allah ﷺ was shining and he was smiling and so happy.

As-Sahabi(صحابي) said: When we saw Rasool Allah ﷺ, when we saw his face we were about to forget about our Salah(صلاة).

It was such an emotional thing for us, we were about to forget our Salah(صلاة) It was going to be a Fitnah(فِتْنَه) for us in our Salah(صلاة).

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه after he completed the Salah(صلاة) he went to his daughter Ayesha رضي الله عنها and said; It seems that Rasool Allah ﷺ is getting better.

So I'm going to go to my wife in As-Sunh(ألصنح).

At that time Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) had two wives, one wife in Madina and one wife in As-Sunh(ألصنح) which was on the outskirts of Madina.

So when he saw Rasool Allah ﷺ standing up and looking at them in Salah(صلاة) he felt that Rasool Ullah is getting better so I can go to As-Sunh(ألصنح) and that is her turn.

Because he would spend one night here one night there. He said: This is her turn so he went to As-Sunh(ألصنح).

But actually, Rasool Allah ﷺ was towards the last hours of his life.

After Rasool Allah ﷺ saw the Sahabah(صحابه) and Allah comforted his heart in seeing the fruit of his Da'wah(دعوة).

The burden of the illness was taking its toll on Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Usama Bin Zayd(أسامه بن زيد) came in and Rasool Allah ﷺ was now unable to speak.

Ayesha(عائشه) said: Rasool Allah ﷺ would raise his hand and then he would put it on Usama Bin Zayd(أسامه بن زيد) and then he would raise his hand and put it on Usama Bin Zayd(أسامه بن زيد).

Ayesha(عائشه) said: We knew that Rasool Allah ﷺ was making Dua(دُعَا) for him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ loved Usama Bin Zayd(أسامه بن زيد) so much, he said: He is the Beloved, the son of the Beloved I loved his father and I loved him

and Rasool Allah ﷺ actually adopted his father as his own son until adoption in that particular way was banned in Islam where the person changes their name

but Rasool Allah ﷺ loved Usama(أسامه) so much he was making Dua(دُعَا) for him.

And then Ayesha(عائشه) said: So I held Rasool Allah ﷺ in my arms.

So I was holding Rasool Allah ﷺ in my arms and he was between the bottom and the top of my chest and I was holding him in my lap.

And then my brother Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) came in and he had a Miswak(مسواك) with him.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ was looking at the Miswak(مسواك) I realized that Rasool Allah ﷺ wants it.

So I told him: Do you want it, Rasool Ullah nodded with his head yes.

So Ayesha(عائشه) said: I took the Miswak(مسواك) from Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) and I chewed it until I made it soft.

And then I gave it to Rasool Allah ﷺ and he held it with his hand and he brushed his teeth, as if he was healthy.

And all throughout, when he was using Miswak(مسواك), he was saying: The highest companion, the highest companion, the highest companion Rasool Allah ﷺ was speaking to who?

He was speaking to the angel of death.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: Every Nabi(نَبِي) before they die the Angel of Death comes and seeks permission from them to take their soul.

See with you the angel of death will come unannounced and take it and leave.

But with the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allah, out of respect for them.

The Angel of Death asks them for permission first and that's when Musa(موسى) punched the angel of death in the well known story in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

Rasool Allah ﷺ was saying: The highest companion, the highest companion, the highest companion.

Rasool Ullah was asking the question of the angel of death and saying I want to be with Allah, the highest companion is Allah.

I want to be with Allah, I'm ready to leave, I finished my mission.

The Deen(دِيْن) is complete.

And then Ayesha رضي الله عنها said: Rasool Allah ﷺ would say O Allah forgive me and have mercy on me and make me join the highest companion, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

Ayesha رضي الله عنها said and then Rasool Allah ﷺ raised up his hand and he would say; The highest companion, the highest companion, the highest companion

until she says his hand went down.

And these were his last words The one, who loves to meet Allah, Allah would love to meet him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was eager to meet his Lord and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ was eager to meet Muhammadﷺ.

This is the greatest disaster that has occurred to the Ummah(امة).

In the narration, it states, whenever one of you is afflicted with a calamity then remember your calamity in losing me your calamity will become insignificant to you.

If you ever go through trouble, if you ever go through a problem in your life remember that the biggest problem of all, the biggest disaster that happened to you

is that Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away.

If you remember that then your problem will be insignificant, it will become small.

How did the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم deal with the situation?

The Sahabah رضي الله عنهم, were very solid men, they were very strong.

They were very capable of tackling any situation but the death of Rasool Allah ﷺ was something beyond.

So Ibn Rajab Al-Hambali(إبن رجب الأحنبلي) says; Ibn Rajab(إبن رجب) says: When Rasool Allah ﷺ died, a chaotic state ensued, some of the Muslims, started to hallucinate

and they didn't know what they were saying.

While some of them sat down, and couldn't stand up.

Some of them, their tongues would not move so they cannot speak and some of them refused to accept the fact that he died.

And Al-Qazi Abu Bakr Ibn Arabi(ألقاضي ابوبكرإبن عربي) he states, he said; And a chaotic stage happened The death of Rasool Allah ﷺ was the event that broke their backs

and was the disaster of their lives.

Ali(علي) went into hiding in the house of Fatima(فاطمه) And Uthman(عثمان) couldn't speak And Umar(عُمَر) went as far as claiming that Rasool Allah ﷺ did not die

and he went to meet Allah for 40 days and he will come back and he will cut the feet and the arms of some people who claim that he died.

So this was a very difficult time in their lives and Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) says: I've seen two days in Madina.

One day was the best day in Madina and that's when Rasool Allah ﷺ came.

Everybody was happy, and Madina was full of light.

And then I've witnessed and lived through the day when Rasool Allah ﷺ died and Madina became dark.

The light was the light of Rasool Allah ﷺ and when he died the light went.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) was at As-Sun'h(ألصنح).

He received the news, so he came riding his horse straight to the room of Ayesha رضي الله عنها.

And he came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and uncovered his face and he kissed him on the forehead, and said: You are pure when you're alive, and you are pure, when you're dead.

And he said: You have went through the death, which Allah has destined for you.

And then he went to the Masjid(مسجد) while Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was speaking.

And when Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه started to talk Everyone left Umar(عُمَر) and they came to listen to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه said; A very brief speech, but it was a turning point in the history of this Ummah(امة), a few words.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه said: If you were worshipping Muhammad(محمد) then Muhammad(محمد) is dead.

But if you're worshipping Allah than Allah is alive and He never dies.

And then he recited the Ayah(آية), one, forty four(144) of Surat Al-Imram(سورة ألعمران) Muhammad(محمد) is not but a messenger, other messengers have passed on before him.

So if he was to die, or to be killed, would you turn back on your heels to unbelief.

And he who turns back on his heels will never harm Allah at all.

But Allah will reward the grateful.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: When I heard that Ayah(آية) from the mouth of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

It was as if it was the first time I ever hear the Ayah(آية).

Even though Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was a Hafiz(حافظ) of Qur'an.

But he didn't imagine that the death of Rasool Allah ﷺ would happen at that moment.

Now this Ayah(آية) was revealed in the Ghazwa(غزوة) of Uhud(أحَد) when there was a rumor that Rasool Allah ﷺ was killed in the battle.

So some of the Sahabah(صحابه) sat down when they heard that rumor in Uhud(أحَد) and said; We're not gonna fight, why should we fight when Muhammadﷺ was killed, we should just stay here.

So Allah is telling them, and if Muhammadﷺ is killed or he dies you would go back to unbelief, even if he dies, you have to carry on with your message

and fight on what Muhammadﷺ was fighting on.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: When I heard Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) recite that Ayah(آية) my feet failed, my legs fails to carry me so I fell down on my knees

and I realized that Muhammadﷺ was dead.

Imagine Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) the strong powerful man his feet wouldn't carry him anymore so he falls down, on his knees.

The narrator says, and then you could only hear crying in the Masjid(مسجد).

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه, was the one, who brought them back to reality.

And Al-Qurtubi(ألقرطبي) says: This is an evidence that Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) has the strongest heart, because who was the one closest to Muhammadﷺ?

it was Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

So if there was going to be anyone who should have failed in this situation, because of the weight of it, it would have been Abu Bakr(ابوبكر),

because he was the one, who loved Rasool Allah ﷺ and has been associated with him more than anybody else.

Nevertheless, he was the one, who brought them back and unified the Sahabah(صحابه) and made them realize that yes, this was the Qadar(قَدَر) of Allah and it happened.

And this is one of the standing moments in the life of Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه a very short speech, but it was a turning point, for the Ummah(امة).

Later on that day, Monday, same day, the Ansaar رضي الله عنهم the Ansaar رضي الله عنهم, started gathering in Saqeefat Banni Sa'adah(ثقيقة بني سعدة)

a shed, belonging to Bannu Sa'ada(بنوسعدة), a meeting place.

In the beginning it was Al-Aos and Al-Khazraj(ألأوس والخزرج) and then Al-Aos(ألأوس) left and it was only Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج).

What were they discussing?

They were discussing appointing an Ameer(أمير).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was busy with the burial proceedings of Rasool Allah ﷺ when somebody came and called him.

Umar(عُمَر) said: I'm busy.

The man said: Come out because something important has happened Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار) have gathered in the portico in the Saqeefah(ثقيفه) of Bannu Sa'adah(بنوسعدة).

And war could breakout.

Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) were two tribes Al-Aos Wal-Khazraj(ألأوس والخزرج) they fought each other for ages and it was Rasool Allah ﷺ who brought them together.

And Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) can come in any moment and cause Fitnah(فِتْنَه) between people.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) went out, and this is in one narration.

In the narration of Bukhari(بخاريْ), it was Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Umar(عُمَر) who went to Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) in Saqeefat Banni Sa'adah(ثقيقة بني سعدة).

When they were going there they met with two men from Al-Aos(ألأوس).

They told them: Where are you going?

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Umar(عُمَر) said: We're going to the meeting place of Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار).

They said: Don't worry about it.

You go ahead and make your decision, Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) - go ahead and make your decision.

And don't worry about Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار), and their gathering.

Meaning this affair belongs to Al-Muhajireen(مهاجرين) you go ahead and make the decision you don't have to go and meet with Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) at this moment.

Umar(عُمَر) said: No! We will go to them, because it is Shura(شورى) we're not going to make our decision on our own.

We're gonna, it's going to be through Shura(شورى), so they went in to Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج).

There was somebody sitting among them who was covered, in a blanket.

So Umar(عُمَر) said: Who's that?

They said: This is Sa'ad Ibn Ubadah(سعدإبن عبادة), and he is ill he had a fever and he was very ill.

Sa'ad Ibn Ubadah(سعدإبن عبادة) was the leader of Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج) And he was the one, they wanted to appoint as Ameer(أمير).

Sa'ad Ibn Ubadah(سعدإبن عبادة) was a very well known figure among Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) and Rasool Allah ﷺ loved him very much.

And they wanted to appoint him as a leader for the Muslim community.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: We went in and we sat down.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: And I was preparing a speech I was bringing together a speech to present.

So he was preparing, what to say.

He said: And then the Speaker of Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) stood up.

This was a formal meeting so one speaker from Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) would stand and he praise Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ that's how they would start their Khut'ba(خطبة), their talk by the Al-Hamdulillah(ألحمدلله), praising Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ

and making Salah(صلاة) on Muhammadﷺ.

And then he said; We the Ansaar(أنْصَار), are the helpers of Allah Ansaar(أنْصَار), that's the meaning of Ansaar(أنْصَار), the helpers.

And we are the battalion of Islam, we are the army of this religion while Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) are a few immigrants, small in number who left their people.

But now they want to strip away from us, this authority.

In other words, this man was saying that the leadership of the community should now transfer to the Ansaar(أنْصَار) after Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And he says that, Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) are the army of Islam while Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) are few in number and that's true Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) were much few in terms of numbers

they were way less compared to Al-Ansaar رضي الله عنه in every battle, the Ansaar(أنْصَار) would be the majority the Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) are the minority

and this Hadith(حديث) is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

In other words he's saying that we should give Baiyah(بَيْعة) to Saad Ibn Ubadah(سعدبن عبادة).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) stood up to speak because he has already prepared the speech.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) said: Umar(عُمَر), take it easy and sit down, until I deliver my speech and complete it and then say whatever you want.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; And because of the temper of Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) I didn't want to anger him so I sat down.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه stood up and he started to speak.

Among the things he said, maybe not all of this speech has survived because there's bits and pieces in different narrations, he said; And what you have mentioned about yourself, the Ansaar(أنْصَار) is undeniable

that's the truth.

When you say that you are the army of Islam, that's the truth.

When you are the helpers of Allah, that's the truth.

And he added to that by narrating the Ayaat(آيات) and the Ahadith(احاديث) that were praising Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار).

And he said that Rasool Allah ﷺ said; If the Ansaar(أنْصَار) would take one way, while all of the other people take another way I will follow the way of Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار).

And Rasool Allah ﷺ said that I am with you my life and my death will be among Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار).

And when Rasool Allah ﷺ opened Makkah, he refused to go back to Makkah and he went back with Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) to Madina.

So Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) brought up all of these Ahadith(احاديث), praising Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار).

But then he said: But the Arabs will never approve leadership in the hands of anyone but the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

The Arabs were divided tribes and every tribe had his own pride.

And it's very difficult to bring them together and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is saying that the only people whom the Arabs would be willing to submit to, are the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Because Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), it has been established in their hearts that they are the nobility of Arabia and they are the protectors of Al-Haram(ألحرم).

And then Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق), he held up the hands of Umar(عُمَر) and Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) and he said; And I would be satisfied with either one of these two men being our Ameer(أمير)

so give Baiyah(بَيْعة) to whichever one you want.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; Everything that I wanted to say in my prepared speech Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) has said it, and better in his impromptu speech.

He said: I was preparing this speech and thinking about it all throughout the way until I got there.

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) he said it, in a better way and a more complete way and he added to add things that I have missed in an impromptu speech.

He said: The only thing that I didn't like was his last statement asking to give a Baiyah(بَيْعة) to me.

And then Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said and Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) look at the statement, he said; In the Name of Allah, I would rather be taken ahead and beheaded

then become an Ameer(أمير), over people and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is one of them.

I would never want to be a leader of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

I would rather die than assume leadership over Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

He saw it as inappropriate.

How could I be in the position of leadership and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is behind me.?

He said: I would rather die, they cut my neck.

Al-Khabbab Bin Mundhir(ألخباب بن منذر) stood up and said; I have a solution, he is one of Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار).

How about a Muhajiroon(مهاجرون) appoint an Ameer(أمير) and we appoint an Ameer(أمير).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: You cannot have two swords in one sheath two swords can't go together, it has to be one leader.

And then there was an argument that happened and the voices were being raised.

So Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: I feared Fitnah(فِتْنَه).

So I went ahead and told Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), Extend your hand forward so I will give you Baiyah(بَيْعة).

And then I gave my Baiyah(بَيْعة) to Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

And then the Muhajiroon(مهاجرون) followed and then the Ansaar(أنْصَار) came and gave him Baiyah(بَيْعة) and they were doing it with such emotions

because they came to realize that yes, how could we appoint an Ameer(أمير), and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is around.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) later on, said: He said: O people of Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) Don't you know that Rasool Allah ﷺ has appointed Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to be our Imam(اِمَام)

who of you can stand ahead and be an Imam(اِمَام) while Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is Ma'moor(معمور).

Rasool Allah ﷺ has appointed him to be our Imam(اِمَام) in Salah(صلاة) and the Khalifah(خليفه) will be the one, who will be Imam(اِمَام) of Salah(صلاة).

Can any one of you lead Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) in Salah(صلاة). They said: We seek refuge in Allah.

So they came back to realize that it is Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), who should be the Khalifah(خليفه) so they all jumped on Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to give him Baiyah(بَيْعة)

and they were stepping over Saad Ibn Ubadah(سعد إبن عبادة), who was ill.

And they were saying be careful, you're going to kill Saad Ibn Ubadah(سعد إبن عبادة) so this wasn't nationalism or tribalism.

They were searching for the truth and whenever they would find it they would hold on to it.

A few notes on the affair of the Saqeefat Bannu Sa'adah(ثقيفة بنوسعدة).

First of all, both Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) Umar  رضي الله عنهما were not seeking leadership.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) as we have mentioned he said: I would rather be beheaded, rather than assume leadership over Abu Bakr(ابوبكر)

while Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه said, in a Khut'ba(خطبة). He said: He said: I've never been eager to become an Ameer(أمير), in any night or in any day

And I have never wanted it to come to me And I have never prayed to Allah to make me an Ameer(أمير) in public or in private But I was afraid that it would become a Fitnah(فِتْنَه)

I was afraid of disunity among the Ummah(امة) and that's why I accepted it I accepted it for the benefit of the Ummah(امة).

And I'm having no rest, I'm having no peace of mind in this position of leadership.

And he said: I have no ability to bear this responsibility, unless Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ gives me strength and I am desiring that somebody is stronger than me, would take it from me.

They didn't want to become leaders, they weren't seeking Imarah(إمارة) Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) says that the reason I accepted it, is to keep the Ummah(امة) away from Fitnah(فِتْنَه).

When Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه said that people would not submit, except to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

There are actually a Hadith(حديث) in that narrated by 40 Among the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم, many narrations one of them, that the leadership is in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

This affair is in the hands of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

That is because of their status.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ said that the position of Khilafah(خِلَافَه) and this is only Khilafah(خِلَافَه) it's not talking about other positions of leadership.

It is strictly speaking about the position of Khalifah(خليفه) the highest position, Khifat(خلافت) Rasool Allah ﷺ.

The Ahadith(احاديث) that indicated the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

There are many indications and hints to the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Number one: This Hadith(حديث) is in, Muslim(مسلم) A women came to Rasool Allah ﷺ Rasool Allah ﷺ made an appointment with her and told her to come back

it's either a question or a certain thing that she needed.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told her, come back and he made an appointment with her.

She said: O Messenger of Allah, what if I didn't find you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: If you don't find me, then go to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani(إبن حجرألعسقلاني), he says; Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani(إبن حجرألعسقلاني), says: In this Hadith(حديث) is an evidence that the appointments of Rasool Allah ﷺ are to be carried on by the Khalifah(خليفه) after him.

And the Khalifah(خليفه) after him is Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and here is a response to Shia(شيعة), who claim that the Khalifah(خليفه) should have Ali(علي) or Al-Abbas(العباس).

This is a very interesting point made by Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani(إبن حجرألعسقلاني).

He says that this is a clear indication that Rasool Allah ﷺ considers his deputy the one to take responsibility in his absence is Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Rasool Allah ﷺ has already made it clear that the Imam(اِمَام) in Salah(صلاة) is Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Salah(صلاة) is؛ the religion.

Now this woman came to Rasool Allah ﷺ, maybe for a Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) issue.

Either she wants Sadaqah(صدقة) or she has a question or...

And Rasool Allah ﷺ is telling her, if you don't find me then go to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

So Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is the leader in the Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) affairs and in the religious affairs, in both.

And in Islam they were combined so the Imam(اِمَام) of the Salah(صلاة) is the leader of the community.

So it's very clear evidence that Rasool Allah ﷺ was actually saying the one who should assume the responsibility after me, is Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

If you don't find me, then go to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Number two, Hudaifah رضي الله عنه said, and this Hadith(حديث) is in Tirimdi(ترمذي).

He said: We were sitting with Rasool Allah ﷺ in a gathering.

So he said: I don't know how long I will last among you but follow the two, who will come after me and he pointed Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Umar(عُمَر).

And he said: And hold on to the covenant of Ammar(عَمَّار).

And whatever Ibn Masood(إبن مسعود) narrates of my Hadith(حديث), then believe in it.

Now Rasool Allah ﷺ was pointing to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Umar(عُمَر) and say follow their way, meaning these are the leaders after me.

Number three, Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه narrates and this Hadith(حديث) is in Muslim(مسلم).

Rasool Allah ﷺ saw a dream, Rasool Allah ﷺ saw that he was sitting next to a pool, and he was drawing water for the people to drink.

In the old days, you'd have a pool next to the well.

So you'd draw water out of the well and you would pour it in the pool so people would drink directly from the pool.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I was drawing out water from the well and pouring it into my pool.

And then Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه wanted me to rest so he held the bucket, and he started pulling out water and then Rasool Allah ﷺ said;

And his pulling was weak, my Allah forgive him.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ says; And then Umar(عُمَر) came and he took the bucket from Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق).

So Rasool Allah ﷺ says: I have never seen a man stronger in drawing out the water like Umar(عُمَر) and when he left the pool was flowing with water and it was splashing.

Ash-Shafie(ألشافعي) gives an interpretation to this dream. He says; The dreams of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), are a form of Revelation.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ said: And there was weakness in the drawing of Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق).

It means that his time in Khilafah(خِلَافَه) will be very short, it won't be long.

And that he will be busy with the Harb(حرب) of Riddah(ردة).

So he's not going to make a lot of opening, so he's not going to spread the water all over.

See, the water from the well is the religion of Islam.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) his Khilafah(خِلَافَه) was very short.

And he didn't have a chance to spread out the religion very far because he only became a Khalifah(خليفه) for a little over two years.

And then Ash-Shafie(ألشافعي) says; His Khalifah(خليفه) wasn't as long as Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of Umar(عُمَر) and Umar(عُمَر) devoted his time in Khilafah(خِلَافَه) to spreading out the message.

Jihad(جهاد) against the enemies of Allah and spreading the Deen(دِيْن) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and that's how the water filled the pool and it was splashing out.

So it's considered that this Hadith(حديث) is also an indication that Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is the next Khalifah(خليفه), and he will be followed by Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

Number four, and this is a Muslim(مسلم) too.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told me, when he was ill.

Call your father Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and call your brother Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن), so that I can write a covenant, a will.

Because I'm afraid that somebody might desire this and say that it is more appropriate for me to be in this position.

But Allah, and the believers, only want Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) Allah and the believers only want Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Rasool Ullah was saying hand me a paper so that I will write down a document stating that the Khalifah(خليفه) after me is Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) because I'm afraid that somebody might come and try to claim it

and say that it belongs to me.

When Allah and the believers want Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Now that did not happened.

Rasool Allah ﷺ did not write the covenant.

And we'll talk about that later on, on the implications of that.

Number five, the Hadith(حديث) of Salah(صلاة), which she mentioned briefly.

And this is in Muslim(مسلم).

When Rasool Allah ﷺ was ill.

They're waiting for you, so he said: Put some water for me.

His temperature were very was very high so he would pour a cold water on his body but then he fell unconscious.

And when he woke up, he said: Did they pray? They said: No!

They're waiting for you, he said: Bring me water and he was trying to prepare himself for Salah(صلاة) but every time, he would fall unconscious,

and that happened three times and then he said; Tell Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to lead the people in Salah(صلاة).

When they told Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to lead the people in Salah(صلاة) He told Umar(عُمَر), Why don't you lead them to Salah(صلاة)?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: No.

You should be the one, who was leading the Salah(صلاة) So here's another indication that Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) considered Umar(عُمَر) to be the second in command after him.

And that's why he told him to go and lead but Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: No.

You are the one, who should be the Imam(اِمَام).

So this is other evidence that the Imam(اِمَام) of the Salah(صلاة) is the Khalifah(خليفه) of the Muslims and Rasool Allah ﷺ clearly said that it is Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Number six, The conversation that happened in the Saqeefah(ثقيفه) the Ansaar(أنْصَار) said; One Ameer(أمير) from us and one Ameer(أمير) from you.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told them. O, people of Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار): Don't you remember that Rasool Allah ﷺ has actually told Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to lead the people in Salah(صلاة).

Who of you would like to be the Imam(اِمَام) while Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is praying behind them.

And they said; We seek refuge in Allah.

We would never want to be ahead of Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

Number seven, Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), he narrates, he says; When Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away.

And we found that he has actually appointed Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to be the Imam(اِمَام) in the Salah(صلاة).

We said: If Rasool Allah ﷺ was pleased to have Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) lead us in our religion, then he should also be our leader in the worldly affairs.

Because the religious affairs are higher in status and since Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was appointed to lead us in religion then it only makes sense that he would also be the one to lead us in our worldly affairs.

And this is a statement by, Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) in Tabaqaat Ibn Sa'ad(طبقات إبن سعد).

Ahlus-Sunnah(أهل سُّنة) have two opinions regarding whether Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه was appointed by Rasool Allah ﷺ as a Khalifah(خليفه) implicitly or explicitly.

Some scholars consider all of these Ahadith(احاديث) to hint to the appointment of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) as Khalifah(خليفه) and to implicitly imply that.

And this is the opinion of Al-Hasan Al-Basri(ألحسن ألبصري) and it's also the opinion of Imam Ahmad Bin Hanbal(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْبن حنبل).

Now, there are some scholars, who consider the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) to be an explicit appointment by Rasool Allah ﷺ because he made him the Imam(اِمَام) in Salah(صلاة), which means that he is the Khalifah(خليفه).

And this is the opinion of Ibn Hazm Az-Zahiri(إبن هزم ألظاهري), and it's also the opinion of some of the scholars of Ahlul-Hadith(أهل الحديث)

and their evidence is also If you don't find me, then go to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) they consider this to be a clear cut appointment by Rasool Allah ﷺ  of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) in the position of Khilafah(خِلَافَه).

Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه), he comments on this by saying that Rasool Allah ﷺ has hinted, and implied the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر),

without writing it down or explicitly mentioning it.

So Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه), he says it was the Hikma(حكمة) of Allah that the appointment of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) will not be done through a document

or a will by Rasool Allah ﷺ that is written because Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) says: If it was done through a document then we would say that Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) was appointed because of that document.

But the way he is appointed now is through the implications of the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ and also through the choice of the Muslims because they gave him Baiyah(بَيْعة).

So it's combined, and it's stronger and it's also an elevation of the status of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) as if Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) is saying that it is common sense it is the expected thing to do

that it doesn't even need to be written down it is so obvious and clear that Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) should be the Khalifah(خليفه).

There is no need for Rasool Allah ﷺ to write it down in the document.

And that did happen, and there was no dispute on the issue and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was given Baiyah(بَيْعة) by the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم.

There was a private Baiyah(بَيْعة) and then there was a public Baiyah(بَيْعة) in the Masjid(مسجد), the private Baiyah(بَيْعة) happened in the Saqeefah(ثقيفة).

And then later on, when Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) was going to give, the first Khut'ba(خطبة) of his, as a Khalifah(خليفه) the rest of the people came and gave him Baiyah(بَيْعة).

Now Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) how come he didn't give Baiyah(بَيْعة) to Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه in the Saqeefah(ثقيفة), in the portico of Bannu Sa'adah(بنوسعدة).

The answer is simply because Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) was the one, entrusted with the funeral proceedings of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

He was the closest male family relative of Rasool Allah ﷺ therefore, he was given this responsibility of performing the burial of Rasool Allah ﷺ,

and the Baiyah(بَيْعة), of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) happened on the same day Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away.

Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away on Monday they gave him Baiyah(بَيْعة) on Monday.

And that's why Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) was late in giving him Baiyah(بَيْعة) but then in the Masjid(مسجد) Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) called him forth

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) came and he did give Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) his Baiyah(بَيْعة), and all of the stories that Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) was hiding

and he refused to give Baiyah(بَيْعة) are false.

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) had an excuse, in not being available on the first day because he was busy with a burial of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

The statement of Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه): Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) says: If this was an issue of confusion Rasool Allah ﷺ would have told the Ummah(امة), what to do would have written it down

but he says it's not an issue of confusion.

The status of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is so high, it's not confusing he is the Khalifah(خليفه).

Ahlus Sunnah Wal-Jama'ah(أهل سنةوالجماعة) considered to be the consensus of the Sahabah(صحابه).

That Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was the Khalifah(خليفه).

So they did it the same day Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away, even before he was buried.

You know, when we talk about the importance of Khilafah(خِلَافَه).

Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away and you had the washing of Rasool Allah ﷺ and burial of Rasool Allah ﷺ and we know that the Sunnah(سنة) is to burry a person as fast as possible.

The burial of Rasool Allah ﷺ ended up being delayed.

The successor of Rasool Allah ﷺ If you don't find me, then go to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

جبکہ ان میں سے کچھ صحابہؓ صدمے کی حالت میں بیٹھ گۓ اور پھر کھڑے نہ ہو سکے ان میں سے کچھ صحابہ کرامؓ صدمے سے گُنگ ہو گۓ اور ان کے الفاظ ختم ہو گۓ

اور بعض صحابہ نے اس حقیقت کو ماننے سے انکار کر دیا کہ آپؐ کا وصال ہوگیا ہے اور قاضی ابوبکر ابن عربیؒ فرماتے ہیں ؛ اور یہ ایک اِنتشار کا مرحلہ تھا، رسول اللہ ﷺ کا وصال صحابہ کرامؓ کے لیے کمر توڑ دینے والا سانحہ تھا

اورصحابہؓ کی زندگیوں کا ناقابلِ تلافی نقصان تھا حضرت علیؓ، اس حقیقت سے بچنے کے لیے حضرت فاطمہؓ کے گھر میں چھپ گئے اورحضرت عثمانؓ آپؐ کے وصال کے صدمے سے گُنگ ہو گۓ

اورحضرت عمرؓ نے یہ دعویٰ کرنے پر مجبور ہو گئے کہ رسول اللہؐ کا وصال نہیں ہوا اور آپؐ 40 دن کے لۓ اللہ سے ملاقات کرنے گۓ ہیں اور واپس آئیں گے

اورحضرت عمرؓ یہ اعلان کر رہے تھے ک جو یہ کہے گا کہ حضرت محمدﷺ کا وصال ہو گیا ہے تو آپؐ اس کے پاؤں اور بازو کاٹ دیں گے تو یہ صحابہ کرامؓ کی زندگی کا مشکل ترین وقت تھا

اور حضرت انس بن مالکؓ  فرماتے ہیں ؛ میں نے مدینہ میں دو دن دیکھے ہیں ایک دن مدینہ کا بہترین دن تھا جس دن رسول اللہ ﷺ تشریف لائے سب لوگ آپؐ کی آمد سے خوش تھے اور مدینہ نور سے منور تھا

اور پھر میں نے وہ دن بھی دیکھا اور زندہ رہا جب رسول اللہ ﷺ کا وصال ہوا، اور مدینہ بے نور ہو گیا مدینہ رسول اللہؐ کے نور سے منور تھا اور جب آپؐ کا وصال ہوا تو وہ نور ختم گیا

حضرت ابوبکر صدیقؓ الصنح میں موجود تھے آپؓ کو نبیؐ کے وصال کی خبر ملی تو وہ گھوڑے پر سوار ہو کر سیدھا سیدہ عائشہؓ کے حجرے میں آۓ اور آپؓ، رسول اللہؐ کے پاس آۓ اور آپؐ کے چہرہ انور سے کپڑا ہٹایا

اور آپؓ نے رسول اللہؐ کی پیشانی پر بوسہ دیا اور فرمایا ؛ آپؐ زندگی میں بھی اور وصال کے بعد بھی پاکیزگی کے بلند مقام پر فائز ہیں اور پھر فرمایا ؛ آپؐ نے موت کی منزل طے کی جو اللہ کی طرف سے آپ کے لیے معین تھی

اور پھر حضرت ابوبکرؓ مسجد نبوی میں تشریف لے گئے جبکہ  مسجد میں حضرت عمر بن الخطابؓ گفتگو فرما رہے تھے اور جب حضرت ابوبکر صدیقؓ نے گفتگو شروع کی

سب لوگ حضرت عمرؓ کو چھوڑ کر حضرت ابوبکرؓ کو سننے کے لیے متوجہ ہو گۓ حضرت ابوبکر صدیقؓ نے فرمایا؛ حضرت ابوبکرؓ کا مختصر ترین خطبہ، لیکن یہ چند الفاظ اس امت کی تاریخ کا ایک اہم موڑ ثابت ہوئے

حضرت ابوبکر صدیقؓ نے فرمایا؛ اگر تم محمدﷺ کی عبادت کرتے تھے تو حضرت محمدﷺ کا وصال ہو گیا ہے لیکن اگر تم اللہ کی عبادت کر رہے ہو تو اللہ زندہ ہے اور وہ کبھی نہیں مرتا

پھر آپؓ نے سورۃ آلِ عمران کی آیت نمبر 144 تلاوت فرمائی؛ ترجمہ؛حضرت محمدﷺ صرف ایک رسول ہیں، ان سے پہلے اور بھی رسول گزر چکے ہیں پس اگر وہ(رسول اللہؐ) رحلت فرما جائیں یا آپؐ کو (معازاللہ) قتل کر دیا جائے تو کیا تم کفر کی طرف پلٹ جاؤ گے؟

اور جو الٹے پاؤں پھرے گا(رُوگردانی کرے گا) وہ اللہ کو کبھی نقصان نہیں پہنچا سکے گا لیکن اللہ شکر کرنے والوں کو بہترین اجر دے گا حضرت عمر بن الخطابؓ فرماتے ہیں؛ جب میں حضرت ابوبکرؓ کے منہ سے یہ آیت سُنی

ایسا محسوس ہوا جیسے میں نے پہلی بار یہ آیت سنی ہو حالانکہ حضرت عمر بن الخطابؓ حافظِ قرآن تھے لیکن آپؓ کے وہم و گمان میں بھی نہیں تھا کہ اس وقت رسول اللہ ﷺ کا وصال ہو جاۓ گا

اب یہ آیت غزوہ احد میں اُس وقت نازل ہوئی، جب آپؐ کی شہادت کی افواہ پھیلی چنانچہ احد میں یہ افواہ سن کر بعض صحابہ کرامؓ لڑائی چھوڑ کر بیٹھ گئے اور کہنے لگے؛

ہم نہیں لڑیں گے، ہم کیوںکر لڑیں جبکہ حضرت محمد ﷺ شہید ہوگئے ہیں، ہم بس یہیں بیٹھیں گے تو اللہ تعالیٰ اس موقع پر فرما رہا تھا کہ اور اگر حضرت محمدﷺ قتل ہو جائیں یا آپؐ کا وصال ہوجائے، کیا تم واپس کفر کی طرف پلٹ جاؤ گے؟

چاہے حضرت محمدؐ تمہارے درمیان نہ رہیں، تمہیں اپنا پیغام پھیلانا ہے اس مقصد کے لیے لڑو جس کے لیے حضرت محمدﷺ  لڑ رہے تھے حضرت عمر بن الخطابؓ فرماتے ہیں ؛ جب میں نے حضرت ابوبکرؓ کو یہ آیت پڑھتے ہوئے سنا

میرے پاؤں شل ہو گئے، میری ٹانگیں میرے وجود کا بوجھ اُٹھا نہیں پائیں تو میں گھٹنوں کے بل گر گیا اور مجھے یقین ہوگیا کہ حضرت محمدﷺ کا وصال ہو گیا ہے

حضرت عمرؓ کا تصور کریں جو ایک مضبوط اعصاب کے مالک تھے، آپؐ کے پاؤں صدمے سے آپؓ کے بوجھ برداشت نہ کر سکے اور وہ گھٹنوں کے بل گر گۓ راوی کہتا ہے اور پھر آپ کو مسجد میں رونے اور سسکیوں کی آواز ہی سنائی دیتی تھی

صرف حضرت ابوبکر صدیقؓ تھے جن کی وجہ سے صحابہؓ نے اس تلخ حقیقت کو قبول کیا اور القرطبی فرماتے ہیں؛ یہ اس بات کی دلیل ہے کہ حضرت ابوبکر صدیقؓ کا دل سب سے مضبوط ہے

اور انہیں باور کرایا کہ ہاں یہ اللہ کی قدرتِ کاملہ کے نظام کے مطابق فیصلہ تھا اور اس پر عمل درآمد ہو گیا اور یہ حضرت ابوبکر صدیقؓ کی زندگی کے نازک ترین لمحات میں سے ایک موقف تھا

ایک بہت ہی مختصر تقریر، لیکن یہ امت کے لیے ایک اہم موڑ تھا بعد میں اسی پیر کے دن ، انصارؓ ثقیقة بنی سعدة میں جمع ہونے لگے یہ پنڈال بنی سعدہ انصار کی مجالس کرنے کا مقام تھا

ابتدا میں یہاں اوس اور خزرج قبائل کے لوگ تھے، اور پھر اوس کے لوگ چلے گۓ اور وہاں صرف قبیلہ خزرج کے لوگ تھے وہ کیا بحث کر رہے تھے؟

وہ امیر کے تقرر پر بات کر رہے تھے حضرت عمر بن الخطابؓ، رسول اللہؐ کی تدفین میں مصروف تھے کہ جب کوئی آیا اور اس نے آپؓ کو بلایا حضرت عمرؓ نے فرمایا ؛ میں مصروف ہوں

اس آدمی نے حضرت عمرؓ سے کہا ؛ باہر آئیں کیونکہ ایک اہم معاملہ درپیش ہے خبر دینے والے نے حضرت عمرؓ کو بتایا؛ انصار، ثقیفہ(پنڈال) بنو سعدہ میں جمع ہیں

اور جنگ چھڑ سکتی ہے انصار کے دو قبیلے اوس و خزرج جو زمانوں تک ایک دوسرے سے جنگ کرتے رہے، اور پھر رسول اللہؐ نے انہیں متحد کیا اور شیطان کسی بھی لمحے آکر لوگوں کے درمیان فتنہ ڈال سکتا ہے

حضرت عمر بن الخطابؓ یہ سُن کے نکلے اور ایک روایت میں ہے بخاری شریف کی روایت میں ہے کہ حضرت ابوبکرؓ اورحضرت عمرؓ ہی تھے جو(اس نازک وقت میں) ثقیفہ کے بنی سعدہ میں انصار کے پاس گئے

جب یہ دونوں صحابہؓ وہاں جا رہے تھے تو ان کی ملاقات قبیلہ اوس  کے دو افراد سے ہوئی اوسؓ کے افراد نے صحابہؓ سے پوچھا ؛ آپ لوگ کہاں جا رہے ہیں؟

حضرت ابوبکرؓ اورحضرت عمرؓ نے فرمایا ؛ ہم انصار کی مجلس کی طرف جارہے ہیں وہ افراد کہنے لگے ؛ اس کی فکر نہ کرو اے مہاجرون! تم آگے بڑھو اور اپنا فیصلہ کرو
